verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers ships a CLI (Wrangler) with a project config that defines bindings, routes and environments, and documentation confirms it fits into Git/CI workflows and supports `npm create cloudflare`/deploy commands, implying config-driven, versionable deployment. However, the evidence pack never explicitly shows a single-file architecture definition (e.g., wrangler.toml spanning multiple services) or version-history capabilities, so this is inferred rather than directly demonstrated.
